C-2 PROVENANCE archive from operating-disciplines.md §8.2 (Scaffolding and guardrails), Arc 47 op-disc debloat cut (stoa--xyb.8). The verbose empirical-anchor prose, archived FIRST then deleted inline (replaced with Anchor: stoa--xyb.8.<this-id> in the slim core).

Empirical anchor. Codified 2026-05-05 during the ariadne-core team_test smoke setup. PRINCIPAL surfaced the over-delegation pattern in a brief that asked the agent to "decide install option 1 vs 2" when option 2 (`uv tool install`) was knowably correct, and similar hand-waving across verification queries, failure-mode handling, and data-shape expectations. The five rules above generalize from those specific over-delegations to the discipline that should apply to every artifact-authoring surface.

This is the N=1 anchor for the §8.2 scaffolding-and-guardrails discipline (five rules: pre-resolve decisions that have a correct answer; provide worked examples; specify failure modes + specific handling; show JSON/data shapes; preserve judgment latitude where judgment is the actual job). The §8.2 RULES + the recursive-scaffolding + bidirectional-translation framing stay inline in the slim core; only this empirical-anchor story relocates here.
